name: Daily county-level mortality data
description: Daily county-level dataset reporting Medicare beneficiary hospitalizations and mortality. For each county and calendar day, the dataset includes the number of hospitalizations and deaths among Medicare beneficiaries.

content.date: Date32[day]: The specific calendar day on which the deaths occurred
content.n_dead: Int64: Number of deaths in the specified county on a given date
content.n_hosp: Int64: Number of hospitalizations in the specified county on a given date
